g.title: TAP_QSP
g.text: Toxic Alcohol Poisoning (Methanol · Ethylene Glycol) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
the parent alcohol is an osmole, the metabolite is the poison: injury = ∫(ADH flux)dt gated by pH-dependent ion trapping
ADH/ALDH kinetics · competitive blockade (fomepizole · ethanol) · formate–folate disposition · glyoxylate branch ratio · CaOx supersaturation
osmolal-gap ↔ anion-gap clock · extracorporeal removal and antidote co-removal · putaminal / optic-nerve and renal endpoints
